iti33:1.1: (Duk. I.) Vuttaṃ hetaṃ bhagavatā vuttam-arahatā ti me sutaṃ.
iti33:2.1: Dvīhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato puggalo yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ sagge. Katamehi dvīhi? Bhaddakena ca sīlena bhaddikāya ca diṭṭhiyā. Imehi kho bhikkhave dvīhi dhammehi samannāgato puggalo yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ sagge ti. Etamatthaṃ bhagavā avoca, tatthetaṃ iti vuccati:
iti33:3.1: Bhaddakena ca sīlena bhaddikāya ca diṭṭhiyā | etehi dvīhi dhammehi yo samannāgato naro | kāyassa bhedā sappañño saggaṃ so upapajjatīti ||
iti33:4.1: Ayam-pi attho vutto bhagavatā iti me sutan-ti ||6||
